services.value: CA Labs provides environmental analytical testing services including asbestos analysis and detection in bulk construction materials as well as air, dust and water samples. It also offers lead analysis and microbiology services including mold analysis (non-viable and viable) and other indoor air quality parameters such as dust characterization, allergens, and bacteria characterization.
